scripts.deploy:staging: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.deploy:production: pnpm run build && wrangler deploy --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc
scripts.db:migrate:staging: wrangler d1 migrations apply goldroad-v2-staging --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env staging
scripts.db:migrate:production: wrangler d1 migrations apply goldroad-v2-production --remote --config wrangler.jsonc --env production
scripts.db:seed:local: pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-dev-seed.ts && XDG_CONFIG_HOME=.wrangler/xdg-config XDG_CACHE_HOME=.wrangler/xdg-cache wrangler d1 execute DB --local --config wrangler.jsonc --file server/db/seeds/dev_seed.sql
scripts.test:api: pnpm db:seed:local && API_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3100 pnpm exec tsx scripts/check-api-routes.ts
scripts.verify:static: pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
